long_biography.plain_text:
At Christian Vision's Digital Day, Lady Tracie Edmiston has made the practical use of technology a central theme of her public leadership. She encourages media practitioners to treat new communication tools as ways of reaching people across languages, cultures and physical borders.

Christian Vision developed from early international projects into broadcasting, social media and emerging technology. As co-founder and co-chair, Edmiston helps set that direction while the organisation produces media, trains churches and supports local partners. Her public appearances bring institutional strategy to practitioners. At Digital Day in 2025, she discussed social platforms, translation software and streaming services as practical tools for communicating across cultures.
